title: DevFlow Metrics Event
description: Schema v1.0 — a single record representing one file touched during development. Every event, regardless of tool or trigger, conforms to this shape.

version.description: Schema version. Increment minor for additive changes, major for breaking.

kind.description: What kind of event. ai_write = Claude created a file. ai_edit = Claude modified existing lines. human_commit = engineer committed without AI writing code.

captured_at.description: UTC timestamp when this event was recorded by the hook.

email.description: SSO email — the join key across all systems

session_id.description: Claude Code session ID for ai_write/ai_edit events

repo.description: Repository name derived from git root

branch.description: Active git branch at capture time

commit.description: Short SHA — populated at commit time

relative_path.description: Path relative to repo root — consistent across machines

line_count.description: Total lines in file at capture time

contribution.description: The core attribution data — what changed and how much is attributable to AI.

signal.description: snapshot_match = multiset intersection used (most accurate). write_count = full file write, no prior content to compare. marker_only = inferred from commit trailer only. human = no AI involvement.

quality.description: verified = snapshot was available and used. inferred = commit marker detected but no snapshot. none = human commit.

ai_added.description: Lines added that are attributed to AI

ai_removed.description: Lines removed that are attributed to AI

net_added.description: Total lines added in this change (AI + human)

net_removed.description: Total lines removed in this change (AI + human)

snapshot_path.description: Path to the raw snapshot file on disk. Internal use only — not for reporting.
